description: Creates an API key for this agent and grants the free starter credits ($5 free credits, no card (first 3 keys per IP per 30 days)). Past the per-IP limit a key is still created, with $0, and the response says so. A key is needed for purchase_data, check_balance, topup_credits and every tool that charges credits; get_network_signals needs one on a paid tier with the engines capability, which the free starter key does not have. Every other read-only tool works without one. email is optional and used for delivery and top-up notices.

email.description: OPTIONAL contact email (for delivery and topup notifications). Omit to register anonymously.
